items.html:
(to the question) Waste that is not final
See above, in answer 31, where three kinds of waste are: the first, those that still belong to the phase of ZA itself, which are the remnants of Hod, Yesod, and Malchut, and these do not come out in the secret of the blood of birth, but ascend to HGT and turn into milk. The second are the remnants that remain after the clarifications of ZA, which are considered waste to it, and nevertheless something is clarified from them, and from them the Nukva of ZA is made, and all the Partzufim of holiness of BYA; and these come out outside in the secret of the blood of birth, but they are pure blood, for from them are clarified all the Partzufim below ZA. And they are the ones called 'waste that is not final,' for they are still clarified to the side of holiness, as explained. They are also called 'the waste of the first eight Sefirot,' meaning the remnants that remain from the phase of the first eight Sefirot of ZA, from Keter to Netzah; for in these remnants ZA no longer has any portion, since these eight Sefirot of ZA were clarified completely, and what remained of them is considered waste to it; hence they come out in the secret of the blood of birth. But the remnants of the last three Sefirot, Hod, Yesod, and Malchut of ZA, are considered one phase, and do not come out in the blood of birth, as above.
